newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up against US dollar after correction.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up against US dollar after correction.

text.p: The Chinese yuan continued its upward trend on Tuesday to close at 8.2963 against the U.S. dollar from Monday's 8.2972, following a correction on Monday, traders said.

The yuan opened higher at 8.2966 and hit an intra-day low of 8.2967 early in the session. It then moved between 8.2963 and 8.2966 for the rest of the session, hitting a high of 8.2920 for a moment based on one trade.
Trading was active, with most done at 8.2965, traders said.
One dealer said the yuan resumed its rise after yesterday's consolidation, giving it firmer support at about the 8.2970 level.
"The yuan's rise was quite slow mainly due to fear of intervention by the central bank," a second dealer said.
He said he expect the yuan to hit 8.2960 on Wednesday.
The yuan closed up at an intra-day high of 7.1000 from 7.1393 against 100 Japanese yen and up at an intra-day high of 1.0722 from 1.0726 against the Hong Kong dollar.
